$comment: Inputs of pnpm build:ascii-armillary (scripts/build/ascii-armillary.mjs), which writes the ASCII armillary GIFs to public/marks/ascii. The renderer is scripts/lib/ascii-sphere.mjs, the ASCII loader's own (pnpm build:logo-ascii); the numbers it shares mean what they mean in scripts/build/logo-ascii.json. The layout is measured from the frame Kevin sent on 2026-11-25: a 53 by 26 grid of 10 by 20 px cells (530 px square), the ring's centre at px (262, 264) and its outer edge 455 px across, one teal (#9fc8d2) on #18181c, and the ramp : ; = ! * # $ @ from least ink to most. shares is each glyph's share of the reference's glyphs in percent, counted from a transcription of its frame (432 glyphs); the script sets the cuts between glyphs at those quantiles of every level in the lap. Only rings are drawn: the outer ring face on, and the meridian and the latitude as whole circles, with no bar, stem or G. Points on a ring's far half are drawn too, their normal facing away and their level times far. The lap turns the meridian a full turn and the latitude a half turn at an even speed, which brings both back onto themselves, so the last frame runs into the first. font is the face the GIF sets the glyphs in, at a size whose advance is the cell's width.
